The funding will allow the organization to address its immediate balance-sheet needs, undergo structural reorganization, and fully reinstate its upcoming 2026–27 performance season at the Schermerhorn Symphony Center.
Crucially, the capital injection allows the symphony to cancel planned furloughs scheduled for October 18, bringing all full-time staff members and orchestra musicians back to work.
